underlying_opportunity.title: 10,000 SATS PROOF-OF-WORK RUN: Who can run the furthest?

root_cause_analysis.defect: Truncated payout hint in demand radar logs (000 SATS instead of 10,000 SATS)
root_cause_analysis.cause: PAYOUT_HINT regular expression in scripts/demand_radar.mjs lacked comma delimiter support in thousands separators
root_cause_analysis.resolution: Updated PAYOUT_HINT regex with comma-separated digit pattern and added fallback title context parser
